Hell RPG v0.1.4.4.5.1 — Demon Knight Elite Foundation

Development source:
  source-assets/character-concepts/2026-09-07/heavenly-and-unique/TransupOrHolyKnight.png

Runtime derivatives:
  dist/assets/enemies/demon-knight/demon-knight-walk.png
  dist/assets/enemies/demon-knight/demon-knight-slash.png
  dist/assets/enemies/demon-knight/demon-knight-hurt.png

The source sheet is preserved unchanged. Runtime derivatives are deterministic
compact crops from verified Expanded-LPC action blocks with a project-specific
blackened/crimson color treatment for the Infernal Dreadknight identity.

Pitsteel weapon derivatives:
  dist/assets/enemies/demon-knight/pitsteel-sword-walk.png
  dist/assets/enemies/demon-knight/pitsteel-sword-slash.png

These are recolored runtime copies of the already-shipping Steel Arming Sword
action assets. The existing player Steel Arming Sword files are unchanged.

The user supplied the character concept sheet for project development. Exact
matching upstream generator credit/provenance for this concept sheet is not
present in the repository, so these character derivatives remain
DEVELOPMENT-AUTHORIZED / ATTRIBUTION HOLD until provenance is resolved before
commercial/store distribution. No authorship claim is created by cropping or
recoloring the source.
